page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 2458 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The combination of high-capacity memory and substantial local storage makes it suitable for workloads requiring rapid access to large datasets without relying solely on external network storage.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC64ads_v6 is classified as a memory-optimized instance. This resource density provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive applications by reducing the need to scale out to larger, more expensive node counts just to satisfy RAM requirements. It is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and data-heavy processing tasks.
